status: Streamed cuts read raw chunks and prove source spans before the cut transaction; locked preparation rechecks database pins and witness hashes.
scope: Offline only; no runtime, acquisition, provider, Docker, contract, pin or chunk-mapping-worker change.

design.preRead: draftCut retains rawFeatures range reads, then reads mapped observations and readProvedAreaPart before pinned. A short context transaction releases its case/source/layout locks before raw storage. The same loadPartFeatures/provePartFeature and integer-token rules produce features, ranges and original positions.
design.witness: Binds the complete input, including raw byte hashes and destination, to proved features/ranges/positions, source identity, original receipt and streamed receipt. Each raw slot retains raw job, chunk index and result hash. Witness passes through draftIntakePartTx and ingestProvedAreaPart.
design.locked: Existing context, approved layout, source/access/code, mapping, duplicate, attempt and package checks remain. prepareProvedAreaPartTx rechecks witness coverage/hashes, unchanged source/receipts, closed raw import and published same-hash raw slots, then uses the pre-read proof. Cut lock order, package identity, normalizer, ranges, hashes and refusal words are unchanged.
design.compatibility: The witness is optional on internal functions; callers without one keep the previous authorized raw read/proof path. This avoids breaking existing internal callers and historical scripts without changing a public contract. Only the streamed draftCut path promises pre-lock raw proof.

tests.coverage: Recording client runs production draftCut, pinned, draft admission, ingestProvedAreaPart and complete raw proof bodies. All modeled storage is outside first-lock-to-COMMIT scopes. Raw hash/publication/closure changes injected after the completed pre-read, another cut's witness, changed receipt/bytes, altered proof and incomplete coverage refuse before writes. Existing mapped/source/attempt fences and raw-feature/range/position parity assertions remain.
tests.inputUse: Uttam real-file prefix tests and 1662-feature NYC exact-byte/range tests pass. Timing repeats an unchanged Uttam feature in explicitly test_only protocol slots; slot identities/offsets are doubles, not a new real original or end-to-end package benchmark.

offlineComparison.hypothesis: Moving raw payload reads and exact feature proof before pinned removes their storage latency and proof CPU from the cut locks while stale witnesses still refuse.
offlineComparison.method: One final before/after comparison using base source snapshots and the same recording fixture: 2000 features, 20 raw chunks, 20 mapped chunks, one source-range boundary; 5 ms per modeled storage call. Context/layout loaders, normalizer and persistence are doubles. Not PostgreSQL contention or runtime timing.
offlineComparison.stop: Passing unchanged-feature comparison plus refusal tests; no runtime extrapolation or tuning.
offlineComparison.statements: Existing case/source/attempt, case advisory, source, item advisory, item UPDATE and mapping fences retain order. Replace interleaved raw chunk storage/proof with closed-raw SELECT FOR SHARE and 20 published raw-slot hash SELECT FOR SHARE statements. SQL counts exclude COMMIT and storage markers; after includes the separate short context snapshot.
offlineComparison.logs: E:/ulpin-tmp/s5-48c/measure-before.log and measure-after.log contain complete locked statements. Earlier processor-boundary-only measurements are retained as measure-preliminary-*.log, not used here.
